name: Amachi Rion
source:
Transfer student. High school senior.
He used to be in the showbiz industry, but came to Hoshinami Island for some reason. He is whimsy but straightforward as he always says whatever he thinks out loud. Because of this, he is easily misunderstood and disliked, but he doesn’t mind at all. A typical city boy as he isn’t fond of insects or fish. He’s a good singer and was once recruited as a vocalist for a band.

‘You’re planning on dying without ever seeing the outside world?’ 

[Translated from [url=https://animal-pla.net/hoshikuzu/]the official website[/url].]
